scope: Combined local workerd verification with simulated RPC outcomes, including seven process-recovery cases and four revert-confirmation regressions. Historical evidence retains its original source hashes and branch counts. Controlled-chain/hosted failure drills, fee replacement and MetaMask/phone acceptance remain open.
